d: Long, flowing dark espresso brown hair with straight bangs and a small ponytail tied with a red ribbon. Sharp, narrow deep red eyes with a calm, focused expression on a youthful, mature face. A slender build wearing a black and deep crimson modified kimono with a white obi sash, featuring a black halter-top bodice and high-heeled black sandals. Accessories include a long katana with a red blade, a white patterned scabbard, and dark red fingerless gloves.
